pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS inst_deliv_2022, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS postnatal_2022, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS inst_deliv_2023, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS postnatal_2023 FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
